bullets.text: Optimized checkout loyalty enrollment through A/B experimentation, increasing Membership Attach Rate by 220% and contributing to projected $2.2M annual GRS.
Decoupled CMS preview from checkout contract creation, cutting load time by 86% from 3.8s to 0.5s.
Engineered end-to-end checkout, cart, and browse features serving 200M+ annual sessions, accelerating feature delivery through rapid cross-functional iteration.
Migrated high-traffic checkout functionality from a legacy monolith to federated GraphQL and Java architecture, improving scalability, maintainability, and service modularity.
Co-founded and led engineering for a zero-to-one mentorship marketplace, scaling the platform to support 60+ mentors through iterative software development.
Engineered a custom scheduling system, eliminating third-party dependencies and reducing operational software costs, saving ~$1,000 per month.
Developed and optimized onboarding, scheduling, and mentor discovery workflows, translating customer feedback into scalable, high-impact product and engineering improvements.
Engineered and delivered multiple full-stack applications for university researchers, managing 100% of the development lifecycle from requirements gathering through production deployment.
Accelerated development cycles through weekly stakeholder demos and iterative feedback, enabling continuous feature refinement and reducing requirements-to-deployment turnaround.
Collaborated directly with university researchers to translate complex requirements into production-ready applications, earning the 2023 Hariri Student Excellence Award for engineering excellence.
Engineered an in-product Excel editor using SpreadJS, enabling in-browser opening, editing, and saving of .xlsx files within Data Explorer.
Integrated frontend spreadsheet rendering with backend persistence, enabling real-time streaming of agent-generated cell operations during AI-planned execution.
Delivered the end-to-end spreadsheet editing feature to the development environment behind a feature flag within three days, enabling controlled testing and deployment.
